svg.font-family: Roboto, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Parallel paths beside projection
svg.desc: Nine timeline lanes from 1960 to 2025 for proximity X-ray, LIGA, electron-beam writing, electron projection, ion beams, multi-beam writers, nanoimprint, directed self-assembly and interference lithography, with dated first-report, milestone, abandoned and still-used markers and reference numbers.
svg.text: [n] = reference on this page; dashed ring = date not cited exactly
